problem: The admitted EntityOS effect could execute before any durable effect intent existed, while causal re-entry was written later. Crash or stale-generation/lease windows could therefore leave an external outcome unknown to UnifiedDB or incorrectly promoted as current.
implemented_contract: UnifiedDB remains the only persistent authority; EffectJournal is transactional policy over its existing effects and causal_episodes tables
persist PENDING before admitted state.noop or EntityOS execution
generic direct host process execution remains forbidden
post-execution session generation and optional lease fence are checked inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction that finalizes the outcome and causal re-entry
stale post-execution outcomes become STALE_OUTCOME with zero causal credit
failed EntityOS attempts become FAILED with zero causal credit
unavailable EntityOS requests become DENIED with zero causal credit
restart-surviving PENDING effects become UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART with zero causal credit
engine reuses the effect journal causal record, preventing duplicate effect re-entry
